design_purpose.cover_distance_m: Keeps the original close host forms visible on approach; native landforms carry longer vistas.
design_purpose.root_embed_m: Seats thin bark/mineral skins into exact native terrain without making another solid shell.
design_purpose.minimum_scale: Rejects cramped anchors instead of reducing a substantial host to a tiny prop.
design_purpose.maximum_scale: Bounded seeded variation of the authored growth forms.
design_purpose.source_clearance_m: Leaves the actual source's dry stance and interaction ray open.
design_purpose.route_clearance_m: Keeps the capsule walking lane clear of tall leaves and roots.
design_purpose.maximum_bank_rise_m: Rejects a root fan spanning an unrelated cliff/void rather than draping across it.
design_purpose.wind_bend_per_m: Small cosmetic leaf movement; woody roots and mineral layers remain still.
design_purpose.pulse_strength: Restrained narrow inner seams explain direction, retention and forks without lighting whole plants.
design_purpose.network_offset_m: Root spine follows the outside of the reserved walking lane; broad fans flank rather than block discovery.
design_purpose.network_segment_m: Short shared low bark segments follow actual support and chunk-local suppression/dig refresh.
design_purpose.network_fan_spacing_m: Connected fan junctions punctuate one approach; avoids uniformly scattering more plants.
